parsed.explanation: No trans-specific offence, and hate-speech, hate-crime and anti-discrimination law cover gender identity/expression. Self-ID and a broadly liberal social climate are positive climate signals. No documented visitor-facing border, facility, custody or police-targeting restriction exists; those axes are open questions, not proven exposures. The real negatives are societal: rising recorded anti-LGBT/trans hate crime, only 8% of victims reporting, dismissive police treatment, clearance falling from 52% to 45%, a Pride mass shooting and ongoing Pride-related threats. Yet the shooting drew the maximum sentence, security services report declining threats, hostility is concentrated among extremists, and general acceptance is documented. This is reduced risk with imperfect recourse, not the low-risk tier of consistently operating visitor protections.
